body: After a detached full gate ends (PASS or FAIL), the lane must let one closing checkpoint settle the host record BEFORE any source experiment in that root (a fixture swap, a stash or a restore). Otherwise the host withholds the gate record because of "differing snapshots". Occurrence 2026-10-17 04:14Z: Sol-license's failed gate test-408b0c46 (record 41aa2989) was withheld because the fixture-swap diagnostic ran before settlement. When directing a failed-gate investigation, say: "first end a read-only turn so the record settles, then experiment". Diagnostics run outside the named root (for example in the master checkout) earn no credit; label them investigation evidence.
